description: This file defines the AppEnv class which manages loading environment variables from a .env file using the flutter_dotenv package. It provides static methods to load the environment variables and retrieve specific variables by key.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: Utility class for handling environment variables loaded via flutter_dotenv package.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the environment variables from the .env file. Must be called before runApp in main().

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable by key, returning null if not found.
